# Bistro texture crops

256x256 crops (offset 896,896) of 24 of the 2048px textures in Amazon Lumberyard
Bistro v5.2 from NVIDIA ORCA, https://developer.nvidia.com/orca/amazon-lumberyard-bistro.
Licensed CC-BY 4.0; (c) Amazon Lumberyard, distributed by NVIDIA. The crops were decoded from
the original DDS and re-encoded as PNG; no other change.

They are what `texture-supercompression.test.ts` cooks, to hold the bytes a large
project's textures cost to move.
